decisions.reason: As a newly launched 2023 security feature that fits the firm's identity-centric platform and likely has low incremental cost to maintain, it remains a worthwhile option while market uptake is still uncertain.

An identity-bound payment wallet is strongly aligned with the firm's secure super-app strategy, so management would keep the option open in 2024 because its strategic value is high and it is too early to infer failure.
Although still unproven, the NFC login authenticator complements the firm's authentication stack and can be kept on the market at relatively low cost until customer demand becomes clearer.
The secure payment and wallet framework had enough importance to receive its own page and directly supports the firm's ecosystem model, so it should be retained as a core growth option.

A secure platform for building multi-service mobile apps sits at the center of the company's stated direction toward super apps and platform business models, making continued support the most option-preserving choice.

The application shielding library leverages the firm's long-standing security capabilities and, given its dedicated page and close fit with established strengths, should be kept while its broader commercialization potential unfolds.
